program_name: Louis Dreyfus Company — Graduate Trainee Program (Agri-Commercial Track)

levels.chua_dat: Below the program's academic standard (1-2 years of work experience as a Trading Assistant or in Business Development team in multinational corporations is preferred. Recent graduates with strong potential of Trading/ Business Development business, from all degree disciplines and with strong academic records are welcome to apply) or the CV does not clearly state GPA/major.
levels.dat: 1-2 years of work experience as a Trading Assistant or in Business Development team in multinational corporations is preferred. Recent graduates with strong potential of Trading/ Business Development business, from all degree disciplines and with strong academic records are welcome to apply
levels.noi_bat: GPA ~8.5/10 (3.5/4.0) or above, scholarship or top departmental ranking; major closely matches the applied track, or holds a double degree/supplementary professional certificate.

levels.chua_dat: CV shows no evidence of English proficiency (certificate, English-medium program, English-speaking work environment). Program standard: Well communication in both Vietnamese & English
levels.dat: Well communication in both Vietnamese & English
levels.noi_bat: IELTS 7.0+/TOEIC 900+ or has studied/worked entirely in English; confident presenting, debating cases, and interviewing on a panel in English.

levels.chua_dat: No leadership role shown: only a club member, or the CV shows no meaningful extracurricular activity.
levels.dat: At least one leader/lead-organizer role in a club, project, or event — with a concrete description of what was actually done.
levels.noi_bat: Club president / lead organizer of a large-scale event / project founder — with measurable results (team size led, budget scale, growth achieved).

levels.chua_dat: No internship/work experience relevant to: Prior internship/ experience in commodities (cashew, green coffee, etc...) industry is a plus
levels.dat: Prior internship/ experience in commodities (cashew, green coffee, etc...) industry is a plus
levels.noi_bat: Two or more relevant internships, or one internship with a measurable achievement (KPI hit, project actually shipped) at a company in the same industry as Louis Dreyfus Company.

levels.chua_dat: No evidence of analytical thinking: no quantitative coursework, data project, or case-practice experience.
levels.dat: Strong problem solving and numerical/analytical skills
levels.noi_bat: Case competition achievements or a real analytical project + solid tools (advanced Excel, SQL/Python if the track needs it) — ready for both aptitude tests and assessment centres.

levels.chua_dat: CV does not mention any award, scholarship, or competition.
levels.dat: Has taken part in an academic/case competition or won a school-level scholarship/award.
levels.noi_bat: Reached the final rounds or won a major competition (case competitions in the relevant industry, national hackathon/datathon) or a national-level scholarship/award.

criteria.label_en: Louis Dreyfus Company culture & motivation fit

levels.chua_dat: CV shows no genuine interest signal or motivation tied to Louis Dreyfus Company or its industry; generic application reasons only.
levels.dat: Good verbal and written communication skills Ability to work independently and thrive in uncertainty situations Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and programming languages e.g., VBA, Python, Power BI is a plus Requires entrepreneurial, good interpersonal skills & team player Possess strong work ethics and humility, high level of ownership and responsibility
levels.noi_bat: A clear, specific story connecting personal motivation, prior projects, and understanding of Louis Dreyfus Company's business/brand/values in Vietnam.

ideal_profile_text:
1-2 years of work experience as a Trading Assistant or in Business Development team in multinational corporations is preferred. 
Recent graduates with strong potential of Trading/ Business Development business, from all degree disciplines and with strong academic records are welcome to apply
Strong problem solving and numerical/analytical skills
Well communication in both Vietnamese & English
Good verbal and written communication skills
Ability to work independently and thrive in uncertainty situations
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and programming languages e.g., VBA, Python, Power BI is a plus
Prior internship/ experience in commodities (cashew, green coffee, etc...) industry is a plus
Requires entrepreneurial, good interpersonal skills & team player
Possess strong work ethics and humility, high level of ownership and responsibility
